# @AUTOGENERATED by scripts/gen_sol_lshud.py; edit scripts/sol_lshud_ranking_source.py.

sol_ls_recalculate_world_ranking = {
	# No location traversal: use the completed country income samples.
	set_global_variable = { name = sol_ls_rank_count value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = sol_ls_top_pci value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = sol_ls_world_pci value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = sol_ls_rank_population value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = sol_ls_rank_income value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = sol_ls_rank_cursor value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = sol_ls_tier_count_0 value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = sol_ls_tier_count_1 value = 0 }
	set_global_variable = { name = sol_ls_tier_count_2 value = 0 }
	remove_global_variable = sol_ls_top_1
	remove_global_variable = sol_ls_top_2
	remove_global_variable = sol_ls_top_3
	remove_global_variable = sol_ls_top_4
	remove_global_variable = sol_ls_top_5
	remove_global_variable = sol_ls_top_6
	remove_global_variable = sol_ls_top_7
	remove_global_variable = sol_ls_top_8
	remove_global_variable = sol_ls_top_9
	remove_global_variable = sol_ls_top_10
	remove_global_variable = sol_ls_rank_previous_1
	remove_global_variable = sol_ls_rank_previous_2
	every_country = {
		# Clear vanished neighbours and excluded countries before rebuilding.
		remove_variable = sol_ls_rank
		remove_variable = sol_ls_percentile
		remove_variable = sol_ls_tier
		remove_variable = sol_ls_above_1
		remove_variable = sol_ls_above_2
		remove_variable = sol_ls_below_1
		remove_variable = sol_ls_below_2
		if = {
			limit = { total_population > 0 num_locations > 0 has_variable = sol_ls_pci has_variable = sol_ls_pop_all }
			if = {
				limit = { var:sol_ls_pop_all > 0 }
				change_global_variable = { name = sol_ls_rank_count add = 1 }
				change_global_variable = { name = sol_ls_rank_population add = var:sol_ls_pop_all }
				change_global_variable = { name = sol_ls_rank_income add = { value = var:sol_ls_pci multiply = var:sol_ls_pop_all } }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:sol_ls_rank_population > 0 }
		set_global_variable = { name = sol_ls_world_pci value = { value = global_var:sol_ls_rank_income divide = sol_ls_rank_population_value } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:sol_ls_rank_count > 0 }
		ordered_country = {
			limit = { total_population > 0 num_locations > 0 has_variable = sol_ls_pci has_variable = sol_ls_pop_all var:sol_ls_pop_all > 0 }
			order_by = sol_ls_pci_order_value
			max = global_var:sol_ls_rank_count
			check_range_bounds = no
			change_global_variable = { name = sol_ls_rank_cursor add = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = sol_ls_rank value = global_var:sol_ls_rank_cursor }
			set_variable = { name = sol_ls_percentile value = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { global_var:sol_ls_rank_count > 1 }
				set_variable = { name = sol_ls_percentile value = { value = global_var:sol_ls_rank_count subtract = var:sol_ls_rank divide = { value = global_var:sol_ls_rank_count subtract = 1 } } }
			}
			save_scope_as = sol_ls_ranked_country
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = sol_ls_rank_previous_1 }
				set_variable = { name = sol_ls_above_1 value = global_var:sol_ls_rank_previous_1 }
				global_var:sol_ls_rank_previous_1 = { set_variable = { name = sol_ls_below_1 value = scope:sol_ls_ranked_country } }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = sol_ls_rank_previous_2 }
				set_variable = { name = sol_ls_above_2 value = global_var:sol_ls_rank_previous_2 }
				global_var:sol_ls_rank_previous_2 = { set_variable = { name = sol_ls_below_2 value = scope:sol_ls_ranked_country } }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = sol_ls_rank_previous_1 }
				set_global_variable = { name = sol_ls_rank_previous_2 value = global_var:sol_ls_rank_previous_1 }
			}
			set_global_variable = { name = sol_ls_rank_previous_1 value = scope:sol_ls_ranked_country }
			if = { limit = { var:sol_ls_rank = 1 } set_global_variable = { name = sol_ls_top_1 value = scope:sol_ls_ranked_country } }
			if = { limit = { var:sol_ls_rank = 2 } set_global_variable = { name = sol_ls_top_2 value = scope:sol_ls_ranked_country } }
			if = { limit = { var:sol_ls_rank = 3 } set_global_variable = { name = sol_ls_top_3 value = scope:sol_ls_ranked_country } }
			if = { limit = { var:sol_ls_rank = 4 } set_global_variable = { name = sol_ls_top_4 value = scope:sol_ls_ranked_country } }
			if = { limit = { var:sol_ls_rank = 5 } set_global_variable = { name = sol_ls_top_5 value = scope:sol_ls_ranked_country } }
			if = { limit = { var:sol_ls_rank = 6 } set_global_variable = { name = sol_ls_top_6 value = scope:sol_ls_ranked_country } }
			if = { limit = { var:sol_ls_rank = 7 } set_global_variable = { name = sol_ls_top_7 value = scope:sol_ls_ranked_country } }
			if = { limit = { var:sol_ls_rank = 8 } set_global_variable = { name = sol_ls_top_8 value = scope:sol_ls_ranked_country } }
			if = { limit = { var:sol_ls_rank = 9 } set_global_variable = { name = sol_ls_top_9 value = scope:sol_ls_ranked_country } }
			if = { limit = { var:sol_ls_rank = 10 } set_global_variable = { name = sol_ls_top_10 value = scope:sol_ls_ranked_country } }
			if = { limit = { var:sol_ls_rank = 1 } set_global_variable = { name = sol_ls_top_pci value = var:sol_ls_pci } }
			# Equality belongs to the middle tier, including an all-zero world.
			if = {
				limit = { var:sol_ls_pci < sol_ls_low_tier_cutoff }
				set_variable = { name = sol_ls_tier value = 0 }
				change_global_variable = { name = sol_ls_tier_count_0 add = 1 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { var:sol_ls_pci > sol_ls_high_tier_cutoff }
				set_variable = { name = sol_ls_tier value = 2 }
				change_global_variable = { name = sol_ls_tier_count_2 add = 1 }
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = { name = sol_ls_tier value = 1 }
				change_global_variable = { name = sol_ls_tier_count_1 add = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	remove_global_variable = sol_ls_rank_population
	remove_global_variable = sol_ls_rank_income
	remove_global_variable = sol_ls_rank_cursor
	remove_global_variable = sol_ls_rank_previous_1
	remove_global_variable = sol_ls_rank_previous_2
}
